newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 17.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
Nicola Horlick, the one million stg a year fund manager at Morgan Grenfell Asset Management who was suspended by her pension fund chiefs, today launched action for unfair dismissal.

The successful corporate financial operator Phoenix Securities is understood to be considering an independent future. An approach by a major finance house is thought to have prompted the move, which suggests that Phoenix may wish to become part of a larger organisation.
GGT DELAYS FUND-RAISING FOR FRENCH DEAL
GGT the advertising group has been forced to delay until February, its cash-raising exercise necessary to finance its acquisition of French organisation BDDP.
HK AIRPORT SET TO FIND FUNDS FOR TAKE OFF

The world's largest infrastructure project, the Hong Kong international airport is set for completion by spring 1998. The project is on target. Officials from the Airport Authority are set to go to the market soon to secure final funding for the project.
GKN-WESTLAND FAILS TO LAND AUSSIE DEAL
GKN-Westland has lost out on a defence deal to supply helicopters to the Royal Australian navy. American company Kaman International won the 30 million Australian dollars (14 million stg) deal.
